title: NEWS UPDATE: HOW TO OPEN A COMM BANK ACCOUNT IN AUSTRALIA
summary: Are you new to Australia, a migrant, a student, or someone looking to open a bank account? Opening a Commonwealth Bank (CommBank) account is simple.
body:
🏦 How to open your CommBank account

Step 1: Choose the account you want, such as an Everyday Account or Savings Account.

Step 2: Apply online through the official CommBank website or visit your nearest branch.

Step 3: Prepare your identification documents. Depending on your situation, you may need:

  • Valid passport

  • Australian driver’s licence (if available)

  • Australian residential address

  • Visa details

  • Tax residency information

  • TFN (optional, but helpful for interest-bearing accounts)

Step 4: Complete the identity verification process.

Step 5: Once approved and your identity is verified, you can start using your account, access online banking and manage your money through the CommBank app.

💡 Need assistance?

If you are unsure which account to open or what documents you need, seek assistance before applying.

🔗 Official website: https://www.commbank.com.au/

📌 Please note: Account approval and identification requirements depend on your individual circumstances.

Share this update with anyone who may need help getting started with banking in Australia.
